description: This file is a Markdown tutorial document explaining how to implement simple OAuth2 password and bearer token authentication using FastAPI. It contains instructional content, code snippets, explanations, and guidance regarding security utilities, form data handling, password hashing, token generation, and dependency management within a FastAPI application.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: A dependency class in FastAPI that extracts OAuth2 password flow form data, including username, password, scope, and grant_type, from form submissions.

classes.name: UserInDB
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing a user with database fields including username, email, full_name, disabled status, and hashed_password.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: A dependency function that verifies the current user's authentication via bearer token.

methods.name: get_current_active_user
methods.description: A dependency that ensures the current user exists and is active (not disabled).
